name: updateSettings
description: Changes how the wall works and the message pinned at its top, keeping every setting that isn't given.

allowAutoSubscribe.description: Whether people join the wall automatically when they open it. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

disableFollowLeaveGroup.description: Whether to hide the join and leave button. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

showMembers.description: Whether people can see the list of members. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

allowCommunityFeedFollow.displayName: Allow users to follow other users
allowCommunityFeedFollow.description: Whether people can follow each other. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

chatFeature.description: How private chats open. Choosing the action item without one set keeps the plugin's own chat. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

chatFeatureAction.description: What opens a private chat when the action item is chosen, such as another plugin. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

actionItem.description: What the extra button on the wall does, such as opening a website or another plugin. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

pinnedPost.description: The message pinned at the top of the wall, as formatted text. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

callback.description: Runs when the settings are saved.

error.description: Why they weren't saved, such as no setting being given.

result.description: The settings as they now stand.

disableFollowLeaveGroup.description: Whether the join and leave button is hidden.

showMembers.description: Whether people can see the list of members.

allowCommunityFeedFollow.description: Whether people can follow each other.

chatFeature.description: How private chats open: the plugin's own chat or an action item.

chatFeatureAction.description: What opens a private chat when the action item is chosen, if one is set.

action.description: What kind of action it is, such as opening a website.

actionItem.description: The extra button's action on the wall, if one is set.

action.description: What kind of action it is, such as opening a website.
